sections.title: Penalty for furnishing incorrect information in reports or certificates.

subsections.text: Any accountant or merchant banker or registered valuer, shall be liable to pay a penalty of Rs. 10000 for any incorrect information in any report or certificate furnished under any provision of this Act or the rules made thereunder.
The penalty under sub-section (1) shall be payable for each such report or certificate.

subsections.text_before_items: The penalty under sub-section (1) shall be payable on directions of the Assessing Officer or the Joint Commissioner (Appeals) or the Commissioner

items.text: where the incorrect information mentioned in sub-section (1) is found by such authority in the course of any proceedings under this Act.

clauses.text: "merchant banker" means Category I merchant banker registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India established under section 3 of the Securities and Exchange Board of India Act, 1992 (15 of 1992); and
"registered valuer" means a person registered as a valuer under section 514.
